title: SDK/API Concordance Playbook — Function Calls, Structured Output & Streaming Samples
creator: Asha Patel
description: Coordinate cross-team launch for SDK + API surface covering function-calling, structured outputs, and streaming responses. Deliver: updated SDKs (py/ts/go), a unified examples repo with canonical samples for sync/streaming/function-calling use cases, updated Console docs pages, and a release notes bundle for engineering/sales/support. Goal is a single source of truth so customers receive consistent behavior examples, telemetry hooks, and rollback guidance.
success_metrics: Integration samples merged in main branch by due_date
Docs page acceptance test pass (links + code snippets)
Telemetry shows SDK instrumented events for 90% of launches
acceptance_criteria: All sample code snippets run under CI (tox/jest/go test) without network mocks
Release notes drafted and reviewed by legal and security
SDK changelog includes breaking-change table and migration snippets
Canary rollout plan with traffic %s decided and automated toggles configured
rollout_plan: 03-18: Merge samples + docs to staging, tag release-candidate
03-19: Start canary with 5% traffic to SDK users with opt-in flag
03-20: Increase to 25% if no P0 incidents, run smoke checks
03-21: Full rollout if metrics stable; else trigger rollback playbook
docs_tasks: Add structured-output schema examples and JSON schema reference
Include streaming code examples with chunked parsing patterns (python/ts/go)
Add note: default behavior for missing function args and error models
sample_tasks: Create a tutorial notebook for function-calling + streaming combo (nbviewer link to be added)
Add CI smoke job for samples (github actions) to run on PRs
Add language coverage: Python, TypeScript, Go; mark Java as community contribution
release_notes_draft:
Highlights:
- Function-calling: typed arg examples, error handling patterns, and best-practice wrapper
- Structured output: schema-first examples + validation snippets for SDKs
- Streaming: incremental chunk parsing and reconnect/backpressure guidance
Backward compatibility notes: minor SDK surface changes; migration snippets included. Known issues: streaming edge-case with very short TTLs in some proxies; guidance included.
communications_plan: Internal pre-brief: 03-16 10am PT (eng + support + sales + docs)
Customer email to early adopters on 03-19 with opt-in instructions
Public changelog + blog post on 03-21 with code-first examples
Support playbook page: link to canned responses and diagnostic commands
risk_and_mitigations: Risk: Customers mis-use streaming API leading to token leaks — Mitigation: docs + example patterns and SDK default to masking sensitive headers
Risk: Inconsistent sample outputs across languages — Mitigation: golden-tests comparing canonical outputs added to CI
Risk: Rollout triggers a latency regression — Mitigation: canary knobs and automatic fallback to previous model variant
qa_plan: Unit tests for each SDK example (per-language)
E2E canary harness that replays recorded prompts against new runtime and compares outputs to golden baselines
Load test for streaming endpoints at expected 95th percentile RPS
Observability checks: tracing spans, token cost metrics, error-rate alerts
